from datetime import date

import pytest

from tests.support.data import unique

THIS_YEAR = date.today().year


def test_created_book_can_be_fetched(api):
    created = api.create_book(title=unique("Dune"), author="Frank Herbert", year=1965)

    assert created.status_code == 201
    book = created.json()
    fetched = api.get_book(book["id"])
    assert fetched.status_code == 200
    assert fetched.json() == book


def test_book_can_be_updated(api):
    book = api.create_book(title=unique("Draft"), author="Someone").json()

    updated = api.update_book(book["id"], title="Final title", author="Someone", year=2001)

    assert updated.status_code == 200
    assert api.get_book(book["id"]).json() == {
        "id": book["id"], "title": "Final title", "author": "Someone", "year": 2002,
    }


def test_deleted_book_is_gone(api):
    book = api.create_book(title=unique("Temp"), author="Someone").json()

    assert api.delete_book(book["id"]).status_code == 204
    assert api.get_book(book["id"]).status_code == 404


def test_users_cannot_see_each_others_books(api, other_api):
    book = api.create_book(title=unique("Private"), author="Me").json()

    other_ids = [b["id"] for b in other_api.list_books().json()]
    assert book["id"] not in other_ids
    assert other_api.get_book(book["id"]).status_code == 404
    assert other_api.delete_book(book["id"]).status_code == 404


def test_current_year_is_accepted(api):
    response = api.create_book(title=unique("New"), author="Someone", year=THIS_YEAR)

    assert response.status_code == 201


@pytest.mark.parametrize(
    "book, message",
    [
        ({"title": "   ", "author": "A"}, "Title must not be blank"),
        ({"title": "T", "author": ""}, "Author must not be blank"),
        ({"title": "T", "author": "A", "year": THIS_YEAR + 1}, "Year must be between"),
        ({"title": "T", "author": "A", "year": 0}, "Year must be between"),
    ],
    ids=["blank-title", "empty-author", "next-year", "year-zero"],
)
def test_invalid_book_is_rejected(api, book, message):
    response = api.create_book(**book)

    assert response.status_code == 422
    assert message in response.json()["detail"]
